annotations.title: Check: get the access of a paying wallet

description: The Check access of a paying wallet, the proof check_credits asks for (access), valid 24 hours. Hand here the signature of check_access_challenge with its nonce and message, unchanged. The challenge is consumed here, once, so the access goes only to whoever holds that signature: keep it secret, it lists this payer's Checks. A challenge of another kind (destination_challenge, the claim of another charge) is refused with check_access_challenge_invalid. Returns { access, payer, expiresAt }.

signature.description: EVM: the EIP-191 or EIP-712 signature. Solana: the ed25519 signature in base58.

transaction.description: Solana: the signed proofTransaction (base64), never sent.

name: check_access
